title: 第十章机缘，遇鸿钧

content_zh:
就在玄元踏入洪荒中部之时，突然感到前方有点异动，元神居然探不进去，玄元不由元神一震，知道有可能是遇上宝物了，要知道自己元神之强在一路上几乎没有什么能够躲得过探查，于是加快脚步，不一会儿就来到了一处山谷，发现没什么结界，但是随着元神的指引，不一会儿就发现了谷底的异样。当需要来到谷底之时，发现一巨大的天坑，这个地方的元气与外边的不一样，仔细感受了一番，突然，玄元好像想起了什么，脸色一变，接着就是狂喜，“要是那东西，自己可是发达了。”
“哈哈哈，真是大造化，居然让我找到了盘古窍穴，这可是大机缘啊。”不一会儿，山谷传来玄元的狂笑，要知道，这可是盘古窍穴，里面蕴含着盘古精气，一个就可造就一个顶级道场，盘古乃是大道之体，而且也是修炼炼体法门，肉身强大无比，其一身明窍三百六十五个，隐窍三千个俱都打通炼成混沌小天地，吸纳无穷混沌之气。盘古陨落后，身后洪荒大地，三千三百六十五个穴窍便成了巨大无比的天坑，内有盘古无穷精气，又称灵脉，其中十二正经又称祖脉，乃是灵脉之源。混沌之气可是好东西，不是什么人都能消受得起，对于他来说，混沌之气，既可以淬炼肉身，洗炼元神，又可以增加法力，在蓬莱岛上他就吸收过混沌灵气，但那只是稀薄的一些，比之这里差远了。
而且最重要的是，玄元可以借此修炼造化道身，突破进入第三层次自从创造出这一法诀出来，玄元也只是修炼到第二层，其原因就是需要的灵气太庞大了，这么多年的吸收也只是碰到了边缘，还差一点才能突破，而今如此大的机缘降临，玄元如何能不激动。紧接着，玄元立马跳进天坑，运转造化道身的法诀，吸收着其中的盘古精气淬炼肉体，就这样，玄元陷入了闭关状态。
时间流逝，三年过去，此时天坑中，盘古精气吸收得差不多了，玄元的身体发出砰砰的声音，那是发生蜕变的征兆，终于，一声长啸，玄元从坑中冲起，一拳打向山峰，轰轰，一整座山体被打碎，看着这效果，玄元满意的点点头，这就是第三层的威力了，只单靠肉体的力量，简单的一拳挥出，就可打碎一座山峰。
“第三层的造化道身，相当于下品先天灵宝的强度了，看来接下来还有一个任务了，寻找盘古窍穴，只要在找到十个这样的地方，一定可以突破到第四层。”按猜想，盘古窍穴在洪荒中部应该比其他地方多，洪荒中部有着不周山，灵气浓郁程度比之其他地方更甚，三百六十五名窍，三千暗窍，在洪荒中部应该还有不少是没有被人发现的。于是玄元开始了寻找，不得不说运气真是不错，还真让他找到了。
接下来，玄元一边走，一边寻找盘古窍穴修炼，肉体慢慢增强，又是十万年过去了，这一日，洪荒中部一处天坑中，玄元正在全力冲击着造化道身第四层，这是他找到的第十一个窍穴了，吸收完精气之后，终于是到了突破的边缘。只见玄元面色扭曲，青筋暴露，显然正在忍受着极大的痛苦，第三层到第四层是一个重大的蜕变，到了第四层，可以说是肉体小成了，肉身相当于中品先天灵宝，可抗太乙金仙甚至大罗金仙都不能一下子斩杀，可以说到了这时，玄元才是真正的无所畏惧。
“吼。”
犹如猛兽咆哮，玄元挥舞着双拳，恐怖的劲气爆发，方圆千里都被轰塌，可见其威力，终于，灰尘散尽，露出玄元那赤裸的身躯，衣衫在突破时已经破碎，双目紧闭，正在适应着突破之后的肉身。
“呼”双目睁开，精光流转，玄元终于突破完成，“现在自己就是面对太乙金仙前中期的高手，也能不落下风了。”自信地说道，确实，玄元不仅肉身突破到第四层，修为也随之突破到了金仙中期，信心更是充足了。换上衣服，玄元走出了此地，继续向不周山走去。

content_en:
Just when Xuanyuan stepped into the middle of the ancient wilderness, he suddenly felt something strange in front of him. The soul could not detect it. Xuanyuan was shocked and knew that he might have encountered a treasure. Knowing that his soul was so strong, almost nothing could escape detection along the way. When it was time to reach the bottom of the valley, he found a huge sinkhole. The vitality of this place was different from that outside. He felt it carefully. Suddenly, Xuanyuan seemed to remember something, his expression changed, and then he was ecstatic, "If it were that thing, he would have developed."
"Hahaha, what a great blessing, I actually found the Pangu Aperture Point. This is a great opportunity." After a while, Xuanyuan's wild laughter came from the valley. You know, this is the Pangu Aperture Point, which contains Pangu's essence. Just one can To create a top-level dojo, Pangu is the body of the Great Dao, and he also practices body-refining methods. His physical body is extremely powerful, and his body has 365 bright orifices and 3,000 hidden orifices, all of which are opened up and refined into a small world of chaos, absorbing the infinite energy of chaos. After Pangu's death, in the vast land behind him, 3,365 acupoints became huge sinkholes, containing Pangu's infinite essence, also known as spiritual veins. Among them, the twelve main meridians, also known as ancestral veins, are the source of spiritual veins. The energy of chaos is a good thing, and not everyone can bear it. For him, the energy of chaos can not only temper the body, refine the soul, but also increase mana. He had absorbed the spiritual energy of chaos on Penglai Island, but it was only thinner, far worse than here.
And the most important thing is that Xuanyuan can use this to cultivate the Taoist body and break through to the third level. Since creating this method, Xuanyuan has only cultivated to the second level. The reason is that the spiritual energy required is too huge. After so many years of absorption, it has only hit the edge and is still close to breaking through. Now that such a big opportunity has come, how can Xuanyuan not be excited. Immediately afterwards, Xuanyuan immediately jumped into the tiankeng, circulated the magic formula that created the Taoist body, and absorbed the Pangu essence in it to temper his body. In this way, Xuanyuan fell into a state of seclusion.
Time passed, and three years passed. At this time, the Pangu essence in the tiankeng was almost absorbed. Xuanyuan's body made a banging sound, which was a sign of transformation. Finally, with a long roar, Xuanyuan rushed up from the pit and punched the mountain. With a bang, the entire mountain was shattered. Seeing the effect, Xuanyuan nodded with satisfaction. This is the power of the third level. With only the strength of the body, a simple punch can break a mountain.
"The third level of the Taoist body of creation is equivalent to the strength of a low-grade innate spiritual treasure. It seems that there is another task next. Looking for Pangu apertures. As long as we find ten such places, we will definitely be able to break through to the fourth level." According to speculation, there should be more Pangu apertures in the central part of the prehistoric era than in other places. There is Buzhou Mountain in the central part of the prehistoric period, and the spiritual energy is richer than other places. There are 365 apertures and 3,000 dark orifices. There should be many undiscovered in the central part of the prehistoric period. So Xuanyuan started searching, and I have to say that he was really lucky, and he actually found it.
Next, Xuanyuan walked while looking for Pangu's acupoints to practice, and his body gradually strengthened. Another hundred thousand years passed. On this day, in a sinkhole in the middle of the ancient world, Xuanyuan was attacking the fourth layer of the Taoist body of creation with all his strength. This was the eleventh acupoint he had found. After absorbing the essence, he was finally on the verge of a breakthrough. I saw that Xuanyuan's face was distorted and his veins were exposed. He was obviously suffering from great pain. The third to fourth levels were a major transformation. By the fourth level, it can be said that his physical body has become smaller. His physical body is equivalent to a middle-grade innate spiritual treasure. He can't kill Taiyi Golden Immortal or even Daluo Golden Immortal at once. It can be said thatAt this time, Xuanyuan was truly fearless.
"Roar."
Like a beast roaring, Xuanyuan waved his fists, and the terrifying energy exploded. Thousands of miles around were destroyed, showing its power. Finally, the dust cleared, revealing Xuanyuan's naked body. His clothes were broken when he broke through. His eyes were closed tightly, and he was adapting to the physical body after the breakthrough.
"Hoo" his eyes opened, his energy flowed, Xuanyuan finally achieved the breakthrough, "Now I can face the masters in the early and middle stage of Taiyi Golden Immortal, and I can not fall behind." He said confidently, indeed, Xuanyuan not only broke through to the fourth level physically, but also broke through to the middle stage of Golden Immortal, and his confidence was even more abundant. After changing his clothes, Xuanyuan walked out of here and continued walking towards Buzhou Mountain.
